integrity_notes: All N>=4 are covered by the analytic proof. No claim of independent external validation or publication is made. References distinguish sources permitting repeated roots from distinct-site masks.
scientific_limitations: Only equal unit weights on four distinct cyclic sites; the Fourier bound at a selected frequency requires that frequency to be primitive. Finite numeric checks are supplementary; longer supports and composite nonprimitive frequencies are outside the claim. An unindexed older equivalent theorem remains possible.
title: Parity and the sharp primitive-Fourier cancellation gap for four-point cyclic masks
